in_sanskrit.name: नर्सि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Man, human being, person. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'nar' meaning 'man, human being'. It is a common name in Hindu culture and is often used for both boys and girls.

in_hindi.name: नर्सि
in_hindi.long_meaning: नर्सि (Narsi) is a Hindi name. The meaning of the name is the same as in Sanskrit, i.e., 'Man, human being, person'. It is a common name in Hindu culture and is often used for both boys and girls.

in_tamil.name: நர்சி
in_tamil.long_meaning: நர்சி (Narsi) is a Tamil name. The meaning of the name is 'Man, human being'. The Tamil root 'man' (மன்) means 'man' and 'innam' (இன்மன்) means 'human being'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'nar' and is commonly used in Hindu culture for both boys and girls.

in_telugu.name: నర్శి
in_telugu.long_meaning: నర్శి (Narsi) is a Telugu name. The meaning of the name is 'Man, human being'. The Telugu roots 'meeda' (మీద) and 'peru' (పేరు) mean 'man' and 'human being' respectively. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'nar' and is commonly used in Hindu culture for both boys and girls.

in_marathi.name: Narsi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Narasimha Avatar of Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narsi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narsi is the name given to the Narasimha Avatar of Lord Vishnu. Narasimha is a man-lion incarnation of Vishnu, who is depicted as having the body of a lion and the head of a human. The name Narsi represents the power and might of Lord Vishnu in protecting His devotees from evil.
